title: Preserve explicit operations on foreign-branch tasks
description: Verify and, where necessary, adjust explicit task operations so foreign scoped tasks remain visible in list/show/graph and can be updated, commented, paused, completed, or started by exact UUID/short ID. An eligible foreign todo/paused task shown from another branch must report readiness.claimable=false and never appear in ready/next, but task start must still succeed after normal assignee/dependency checks. Add focused provider/CLI tests for foreign short-ID resolution, explicit start, status movement, comments, updates, and ambiguous/unknown identifiers. Do not add a force or steal flag.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Inspected repository guidance and existing branch-scope implementation. Explicit UUID/short-ID operations already resolve globally, but focused foreign-task operation coverage is missing; I’m verifying start assignee semantics and CLI/provider behavior before patching.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Added focused provider and process-level CLI coverage: foreign scoped tasks stay visible in list/show/graph with readiness.claimable=false and are excluded from ready/next; exact UUID/short-ID update, comment, dependency-gated start, pause, restart, and done operations succeed; unknown and ambiguous CLI identifiers are rejected. go test ./..., git diff --check, and ./scripts/verify.sh commit all pass.
